semantics.order: E0 is the weakest condition and Ek is the unmasked strongest condition.
semantics.stronger_condition_rule: A stronger condition may only restore pointers removed from a weaker condition.
semantics.truth_isolation: Known evaluator-only keys are rejected recursively before and after masking.
semantics.determinism: Every condition is independently derived from one canonical source packet; canonical JSON and SHA-256 identify source, mask, and output.

limitations: Mechanism-specific land ladders and source-packet adapters remain development work and must be frozen before confirmation.
The generic builder does not declare evidence sufficient; P4 evaluator references and public claim requirements make that determination.
Legacy masks remain immutable and are not silently converted into independent samples.
next_gate: P4 evaluator-only highest-defensible-diagnosis references for each episode and evidence condition.
